records.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing
records.reason: The study extends recurrent-model inference beyond nominal step budgets and measures exact-solve completion on hard Sudoku, with latent-state stability analysis. It shows additional computation can rescue some nominal-budget failures, but does not propose an efficiency improvement or general LLM serving method; the benchmark is narrow and model-specific.

records.title: Toki: Profiling HBM Performance on FPGA Systems with RISC-V Soft Cores and PCIe Host DMA Traffic
records.reason: Toki is a profiling framework for HBM performance with RISC-V FPGA soft cores and PCIe DMA, measuring memory access patterns, locality, contention and host traffic. Its primary full text makes it plausibly adjacent to the linked FPGA LLM-inference/offload lineage, but it evaluates general workloads/microbenchmarks rather than LLM inference directly, so retain as borderline for a concrete workload-fit check.
